title: SPARK: Learning from Verification in Speculative GRPO Rollouts
abstract: arXiv:2608.04962v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a standard approach for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models, but its training is costly because each step requires generating many long reasoning responses. Recent methods use speculative decoding to accelerate the rollouts, where a draft model proposes tokens that the target model verifies. However, we find that the draft model repeatedly misses the same tokens within a response and across responses in the same GRPO group, and the verification feedback on these misses is not used to update the draft during the rollout. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce SPARK, a lightweight self-adaptive mechanism designed to enhance draft models used in speculative GRPO training. SPARK leverages target verification feedback to refine draft predictions during generation while preserving their existing training procedures. Averaged across 21 model-dataset settings

translated_title: SPARK：从推测性GRPO采样中的验证学习
translated_abstract: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的标准方法，但其训练成本高昂，因为每一步都需要生成大量冗长的推理响应。近期方法采用推测解码来加速采样过程，即由草稿模型提出候选token，再由目标模型进行验证。然而，我们发现草稿模型在单个响应内以及同一GRPO组内的多个响应之间会反复遗漏相同的token，而这些遗漏处的验证反馈并未用于在采样过程中更新草稿模型。基于这一分析，我们提出了SPARK，一种轻量级的自适应机制，旨在增强推测性GRPO训练中使用的草稿模型。SPARK利用目标模型的验证反馈在生成过程中修正草稿模型的预测，同时保留其原有的训练流程。在21个模型-数据集设置上的平均结果显示……
tldr: 提出SPARK，一种轻量级自适应机制，利用目标模型的验证反馈在推测性GRPO训练的采样过程中实时修正草稿模型的预测遗漏，从而提升训练效率。
